remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1942. Sold to Duncan Phillips." Backing inscription dates 1940. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1942. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1940. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 dates 194.0. Dated 1940 on basis of backing inscription 1, 1941 purchase date, inclusion in 1941 New York (An American Place) exhibition, and Stieglitz—O'Keeffe correspondence. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks associate work with no. Sin 1943 New York (An American Place) exhibition, but work was purchased in 1941, and included in 1941 exhibition as no. 8. Reproduced and titled *White Place in Shadow* in *Time* (May 194–6); *The White Place in Shadow* in *New York Herald Tribune* (May 1946). See cat. no. 1939. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Two dark purple figs with green stems sit on a white surface, one upright and the other on its side. The surface and the background appear as though formed of draped fabric or crinkled paper.
title: From The White Place
